notes: Diagnostic source copies only. Atomic counters and these binaries are never used for latency comparisons.
All 962 official queries and 714 supplemental terms on the immutable full corpus, all four commands, two independently equal passes. Supplemental rows are distinguished by position, not query string.
Counter meanings are defined in counter-fields.json. Payload bytes count encoded decoder input, not physical I/O, metadata, or resident memory. Inline postings are outside block decode totals.

Cross-source gates compare all ordered top-1000 IDs and raw score bits across V4, V9 and the new phrase planner, and compare each source pruned top-10/100/1000 with exhaustive results on rounded and group indexes. Exact counts agree with Tantivy.
Tantivy 0.26.0 is checksum-verified with the same pinned dependencies as the timing adapter; only diagnostic source path substitution and counters differ. Frozen sources include licenses.
Different engine document order and encodings affect block work. These counts diagnose traversal and decode work, and do not by themselves establish a speedup.

Byte-identical oracle outputs and source archives are stored once. file-aliases.json maps every omitted original path to its exact stored bytes; file-manifest.json retains all logical paths and hashes. After extracting, restore_aliases.py reconstructs and verifies those paths. No query, count, score bit or diagnostic record is dropped.
